name: True treasure
source:
"As long as I have you..."

　　"I want to protect you... that's all I want."

"I am always by your side."

　　"It's how I show my love..."

―I'm not scared.
Because... I have you.

[Translated from [url=http://web.archive.org/web/20091003214443/http://park23.wakwak.com/~namikazenouta/true/index.htm]official website[/url]]
